app_fee.value: There is no application fee for research degrees; submitting an application costs nothing.
app_fee.quote: There is no cost involved in submitting an application.

fee_waiver.value: No application fee applies, so there is no fee to waive.
fee_waiver.quote: There is no cost involved in submitting an application.

gre_general.value: The UWA research degree pages fetched do not mention the GRE, so no GRE rule is stated.

toefl_min.value: The Graduate Research School sets the English standard for research students, and the score is not published on the pages fetched.
toefl_min.quote: All applicants for a Higher Degree by Research course, including Australian applicants, must satisfy the requirements for English language competence set by the Graduate Research School.

ielts_min.value: The Graduate Research School sets the English standard for research students, and the score is not published on the pages fetched.
ielts_min.quote: All applicants for a Higher Degree by Research course, including Australian applicants, must satisfy the requirements for English language competence set by the Graduate Research School.

english_waiver.value: The Graduate Research School sets English rules for research students, and the pages fetched do not say whether a degree taught in English in India is accepted. The exempt-country list on the English page is for coursework degrees and does not name India.
english_waiver.quote: All applicants for a Higher Degree by Research course, including Australian applicants, must satisfy the requirements for English language competence set by the Graduate Research School.

notes: Research degrees use one PhD (Doctor of Philosophy) for all disciplines. The English page says higher HDR English scores apply in some schools only (Law, Graduate School of Education, Dental clinical projects, Business), none of them STEM. Scholarship rounds are in the scholarships section and are not fee rules. The 2027 international round closed 15 September 2026.
